owed.change: RETIRE the filename-guessing alt-text generator this board draws. AssetDetailOverlay.tsx:270-289 sends only the FILE NAME to the generic text endpoint, has no provenance, no skip case and fails silently — while the full library's details panel calls a vision path that looks at the image, shows a provenance chip, handles 'you already wrote alt text, I kept yours' and toasts on failure. Both are mounted inside the same full-page library (LibraryManager.tsx:395 and :532), so one asset can get two different answers. One generator, the vision one, reached from both surfaces, with one contract: provenance chip, skip-if-user-wrote-it, visible failure, Regenerate.
owed.why: Alt text produced from a filename is worse than no alt text: it looks authoritative and is unverifiable.
